Definition: After-tax operating profit, one-offs removed, per dollar of invested capital
Evidence: Mauboussin, Measuring the Moat; McKinsey, Valuation

Definition: Minimum return a business should earn on capital
Return on capital added over 3 years
Formula: Change in NOPAT / change in invested capital (3 yrs)

Definition: Revenue minus cost of revenue, as a share of revenue
Gross profit per dollar of assets
Share of extra revenue that became operating profit
Formula: Change in clean OI / change in revenue (3 yrs)

Definition: Overhead per dollar of sales (lower is better)
Revenue growth above the industry median
Move in industry rank on ROIC, margins, turnover
Share of profit that became free cash
Profit not backed by cash (lower is better)
How much is reinvested and at what return
Formula: (Change in capital / NOPAT) x incremental ROIC

Definition: Operating profit per dollar of interest
Years of cash profit to repay net debt (999 = EBITDA zero or negative)
Distress score from four ratios, book values
Share of core items tagged over 5 years
